content.name: EOC - Executive Operations Center
content.description:
# EOC - Executive Operations Center
Transform your X4 empire from reactive management into intelligent operations.
EOC continuously observes your empire, understands what each station is trying to accomplish, identifies recurring operational problems, and provides evidence-based recommendations while keeping every important decision under your control.
---
## Important Startup Timing
After loading a game, wait approximately **10 seconds** for EOC to complete its initial station scan before opening the Executive Operations Center. The readiness summary confirms that current operational intelligence is available.
---
# What EOC Does
### Understands Your Empire EOC doesn't simply report numbers. It learns what your stations are designed to do, understands their operational role, recognizes temporary mission-driven activity, and helps you focus on the problems that actually matter.
### Executive Intelligence Monitor empire health, operational KPIs, trends, ranked priorities, and executive summaries that quickly identify where your attention is needed most.
### Intelligent Station Management Assign persistent station roles and receive recommendations tailored to each station's purpose. Shipyards, mining operations, production facilities, food stations, technology centers, and hybrid complexes are evaluated against what they are supposed to accomplish—not generic rules.
### Guided Recovery Instead of simply identifying a problem, EOC explains the primary blocker, presents supporting evidence, recommends the next player action, and verifies whether conditions actually improved after corrective action.
### Mission-Aware Analysis EOC recognizes when stations are supporting major mission objectives such as Terraforming. Temporary spikes in production, logistics, or resource consumption are understood as intentional mission activity instead of being incorrectly reported as operational failures.
### Smart Trade, Shipping, and Logistics Register eligible ships, identify supply shortages, recommend or assign logistics within player-approved authority, and improve empire-wide resource movement without bypassing normal X4 gameplay.
### Fleet Build Manager Create reusable fleet templates, search owned blueprints, preview construction at one or multiple player-owned shipyards, and confirm builds only after deliberate player approval.
### Cases and Operational Verification Track critical, warning, monitored, and player-requested cases while continuously verifying whether conditions are **Resolved, Improving, Unchanged,** or **Worsening** based on fresh operational evidence.
### Executive Reports Generate immediate operational reports while automatically maintaining permanent copies in the Logbook Tips system for future reference.
### Always Player Controlled EOC advises first and acts only within authority explicitly granted by the player. Every automated capability remains bounded by player approval. No free ships, no hidden automation, no resource bypasses, and no unauthorized credit movement.
### Integrated Into X4 Launch EOC directly from Dock Interactions or the EOC pinwheel for immediate access to your empire's operational intelligence. Name your Executive Operations Center, enjoy a guided startup sequence, and experience an advisor designed to understand your empire—not just monitor it. ---
# Updated Features in EOC 3.0 GA
### Live KPI Center Adds page-scoped 10-second live sampling for executive cash flow, station account movement, construction progress, ware shortages, trade activity, logistics health, storage levels, workforce health, shipyard activity, case trends, and empire growth. Sampling stops when KPI Center closes or another page opens.
### Searchable KPI Filters and Safe Controls Adds complete applicable station and shipyard filter lists with ALL options, stable construction-record filtering, obvious accented control labels, protected dropdown interaction, and correctly routed KPI dashboard buttons.
### Construction and Resource Drilldowns Adds station-under-construction selection, compact all-station construction summaries, module-by-module selected-station progress, and resource-level shortage current, target, and shortfall detail.
### Bounded, Readable Live Views Enforces a hard eight-row visible KPI budget, reports hidden-row counts, prevents X4 widget-height overflow, and preserves the player's visible scroll window and selected row across automatic refreshes.
### Historical Operational Trends Adds bounded live-session histories for critical, warning, other, and total cases plus station, registered-ship, construction-record, and EOC ship-order growth.
### Verified Specialized Health Views Adds workforce-specific population and provision information, storage-type usage and capacity details, EOC-registered logistics health, and shipyard queue and EOC-created order visibility without inventing unavailable X4 values. ---
# New in EOC 3.1 GA
Adds event-driven Dock Interactions visibility tracing across callback registration, button rendering, player selection, and EOC open-event receipt. The integration remains bounded, adds no recurring watchdog, and makes no automation or authority changes.
